Set q-speech-nemotron of the sealed 2026-09-06 MF-7b pass. It is the SAME vector whose cosine against the 11,514 sealed TRAIN facet vectors produced the neighbour half of this cell's candidate bank; no text of any kind enters it.

arm_basis: speech-feature-query, the SAME arm and the SAME audio path the sealed closed-list comparator flew: mmproj-free decode over pre-materialized encoder packets from the registered DEV-1000 promotion receipt, one input_speech_features QUERY descriptor per contact, one contact per sample. KU-S4N adds no packet: its whole mechanism is text-typed supply. The k exemplar packets belong to KU-S4a/KU-S4b, which are blocked on a packet-promotion precondition.
instruction_basis: The system message is byte-identical to the sealed closed-list comparator's own: the sealed 2026-08-25 DEV-1000 M0 instruction (sha256 cef527896e9beef5774305e01dc29192fc2d5ca89fba5143e82f0b91a7cb86b8, 5,747 characters) plus the 1,836-character closed label inventory suffix, rendered from the same hash-pinned template and the same registered fill. Rendered sha256 4073f79ef25c4796b0a46cb2ac7f5d4982c83084982b87ddd8a70504090d37db, 7,583 characters. The candidate set is NEVER written into it.
the_one_difference_from_the_sealed_compa: TWO things move against the sealed rows and the preregistration says so out loud rather than claiming one. (1) The mechanism: eight typed candidate blocks arrive as traced supply. (2) The harness: the comparator flew policy 'fixed' through FlightRuntime._run_speech_feature_direct with no history, and a supplied phase can only be expressed as a phase program, which adds exactly one ORG/CONTROL history turn carrying probes/slurp_phase_direct.txt (rails.core_client._agent_history) -- the same turn configs/baseline/slurp-phase-direct-only-v1.json documents. The TWIN carries that turn too, so the twin contrast isolates the mechanism alone; the comparator contrast carries the control turn as a declared covariate.
what_the_supply_is: The one factor. For each DEV row, the gold-free candidate set sealed in the candidate bank: the comparator's own PREDICTED scenario's legal intents in TRAIN-prior order (up to three) unioned with that row's speech-vector neighbours' distinct intents in cosine rank order, capped at k=8. The decision is model-free and pre-flight (scripts/slurp_kus4_prep.py, row SAEA-SLURP-MF-KU-S4-PREP-V1); rails.knowledge_provider.SlurpIntentCandidateProvider serves it and rails.phase_supply.build_bootstrap_selection seeds it into each sample's initial QueryState, because the supplied phase is the program's FIRST phase and no advance precedes it. It reaches the model ONLY as typed content blocks carrying evidence_id / source_uri / knowledge_role='value'.
what_this_is: Cell KU-S4N of the 2026-09-08 owner Decision 10 SLURP intent family: NARROWING ONLY. The sealed closed-list comparator's prompt, roster, packets, build, geometry and decoding, with a k=8 gold-free intent candidate set supplied as traced knowledge and the deterministic legality judge attached as a record-only reviewer.
why_np8: The comparator's own geometry, held fixed so the paired contrast is geometry-matched. The candidate blocks add about 110 proxy tokens and the control turn about 50, against a realized comparator prompt of 2,190 tokens and an 8,192-token slot; the projection is in the preparation receipt and the SERVER fit is measured before takeoff.
why_the_bank_is_a_file: The candidate rule unions a cosine over sealed vectors with the comparator's OWN sealed response, and no cosine can express the second half. rails.phase_supply implements exactly one query-source kind for that reason -- a decision that cannot be recomputed in flight is computed before it, pinned by sha256 and re-verified at preflight. The bank is that artifact; both selections live in one file so the twin's exclusion rule is verifiable from the artifact rather than from two files a reader has to trust were produced together.
why_the_judge_is_record_only: phase_review with on_flag='record' changes not one byte of what the flight sends (rails.phase_review module docstring), so the judge is a core-pressure covariate and not a second factor. Its interceptions on the sealed comparator rows are already measured model-free -- 42 of 1,000 rows flagged, 25 of them still wrong after the projection -- and the flight records the same quantity on its own rows.
why_the_review_material_is_injected: slurp-legal-label-flag-v1 reads a built LegalIntentInventory; a 60-pair inventory is carrier material, not a config knob, so it arrives through FlightRuntime.bind_phase_review_material exactly as rails.phase_review's docstring prescribes. The judge id still has to resolve in core.base.JUDGES.
